newsitem.title: UK: Kleinwort rates Mexico CONTAL long term Buy.
newsitem.headline: Kleinwort rates Mexico CONTAL long term Buy.

text.p: Kleinwort Benson Research said on Tuesday it was initiating coverage of Mexico's CONTAL, Coca Cola's third largest Mexican bottler, with a long term "Buy" recommendation.
"CONTAL (Grupo Continental) is benefiting from its vertical integration, market position and experienced management," Kleinwort Benson analyst Enrique Klix said in a note to investors.
"We are forecasting earnings growth of 15 percent and 10 percent in 1997 and 1998 respectively," he said.
Coca Cola and PepsiCo have been engaged in a bitter corporate war for market share worldwide.
A recent study identifies Mexico as the world's biggest cola consumer outside the United States, giving Coca Cola 61 percent and Pepsi 21 percent of the Mexican market share.
Klix said CONTAL's vertical integration was signalled by its participation in two refined sugar mills and the largest Coca Cola bottling plant in Mexico.
He predicted earnings growth of 13, 15 and 10 percent in 1996, 1997 and 1998 respectively, based on a steady recovery in demand, combined with a growing market share and greater efficiencies.
He posted a six-month target price of 38 pesos per share, giving an upside potential of 18 percent.

"Trading at 13.4 times and 12.2 times estimated earnings for 1997 and 1998 respectively, we believe that the shares are attractively valued," he said. --Caroline Brothers, London Newsroom +44 171 542 2734
